objects.title: Human Development, Health, & Education From A Global Perspective
objects.description: Intended to address the University's global community objectives and provide scholarly background on human development in other cultures.

objects.title: Independent Studies
objects.description: Creative projects, including research and design, which are supervised on an individual basis and which fall outside the scope of formal courses.

objects.title: Special Topics
objects.description: Formal courses given infrequently to explore, in depth, a comparatively narrow subject which may be topical or of special interest.
